sources.entry: alive-progress - A new kind of progress bar, with real-time throughput, ETA and very cool animations.

summary.one_liner: alive-progress is a Python progress bar library with a live spinner, real-time throughput and ETA, animated bars, print/logging hooks, and a pausable mode.
summary.what_it_does: Wraps any loop in an alive_bar context manager (or an alive_it iterator adapter) and renders a terminal progress bar with a percentage or counter, throughput, and ETA. It also animates a spinner that speeds up or slows down with processing rate, and in unknown mode (no total) animates the bar itself. Print and logging calls are enriched with the current bar position, and a final receipt with total items, elapsed time and throughput is printed on completion. Items can be marked as skipped so they don't distort the ETA, and manual mode lets you set the bar by percentage. The README also describes a Pause Mechanism that lets you suspend the bar, return to the Python prompt, and resume. Styling is customizable through built-in spinner, bar and theme names, factories, and a check() tool to preview animations, with settings configurable per bar or globally via config_handler.
use_cases: show progress of a long-running Python loop
estimate time remaining for batch processing
log or print messages without breaking a progress bar
resume a job with already-completed items skipped
pause a running script to fix items manually
design custom spinner or bar animations for terminal output
how_to_run: with alive_bar(total) as bar: for item in items: process(item); bar()
from alive_progress import alive_it; for item in alive_it(items): ...
notable: Pause mechanism that suspends the bar and resumes the same processing after manual intervention
Spinner speed reacts to actual throughput
Print and logging hooks add the current bar position to messages
Spinner compiler and check() tool for designing custom animations
Skipped-item tracking keeps throughput and ETA accurate on resumed jobs
caveats: README mentions Jupyter support is experimental, with possible visual glitches
Bar and spinner styling is extensive and can be complex to customize
